title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing
abstract: arXiv:2610.27559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical natural language processing includes diverse tasks such as information extraction, classification, and question answering. Developing one model for all tasks could simplify deployment and improve knowledge transfer. We evaluated whether small recurrent-depth language models can meet this need through joint fine-tuning and compared their performance with standard transformers. We fine-tuned Ouro1.4B-Thinking, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, HRM-Text-1B, Qwen3-1.7B, and Qwen3-8B on 9 datasets covering information extraction, classification, inference, and question answering, and evaluated them on four additional datasets excluded from training. Across these 13 datasets, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking achieved higher performances than Qwen3-1.7B on 11 datasets; Ouro-2.6BThinking was competitive with Qwen3-8B on most tasks. Ouro models showed the largest gains on inference and question answering, whereas HRM-Text-1B showed mixed results. These findings sup

translated_title: 探索循环深度语言模型用于多任务临床文本处理
translated_abstract: 临床自然语言处理包括信息抽取、分类和问答等多种任务。开发一个适用于所有任务的模型可以简化部署并促进知识迁移。我们评估了小型循环深度语言模型能否通过联合微调满足这一需求，并将其性能与标准Transformer模型进行比较。我们在涵盖信息抽取、分类、推理和问答的9个数据集上对Ouro-1.4B-Thinking、Ouro-2.6B-Thinking、HRM-Text-1B、Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-8B进行了微调，并在4个未参与训练的额外数据集上进行评估。在这13个数据集中，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking在11个数据集上的表现优于Qwen3-1.7B；Ouro-2.6B-Thinking在大多数任务上与Qwen3-8B相当。Ouro模型在推理和问答任务上取得了最大提升，而HRM-Text-1B的表现则好坏参半。这些发现支持……
tldr: 小型循环深度语言模型（如Ouro系列）通过多任务联合微调，在13个临床NLP数据集上以更小的参数量达到了与更大规模标准Transformer相当甚至更优的性能，尤其在推理和问答任务上优势显著。
en_tdlr: Small recurrent-depth language models like Ouro, through joint fine-tuning, match or outperform larger standard transformers across 13 clinical NLP datasets with far fewer parameters, showing the largest gains on inference and question answering tasks.
